description: Teamwork Graph CLI is Atlassian's agent-first interface to your entire work context: Jira issues, Confluence pages, Bitbucket PRs, along with your connected third-party data sources. Purpose-built for coding agents like ChatGPT Work & Codex (terminal or desktop), and powered by Atlassian's context graph. Try: "draft a Jira issue from this PR and link it to the epic." Using ChatGPT in the browser? Install the Atlassian Rovo MCP plugin instead. Run /twg-setup after install to connect Atlassian Teamwork Graph CLI to ChatGPT Work or Codex.
